decisions.reason: Inserting a before plural type systems is ungrammatical.
The isolated rewrite breaks the parallel construction with incorporate.
The context requires witness, not withes.
Relevant does not preserve the discussion being independent of the chosen model formalism.
The source asserts additional analogous lemmas, rather than comparing the preceding lemma with them.
TeX closing quotes are valid syntax, not extra punctuation.
The singular system requires is, not are.
Deleting where breaks the continuation after the displayed theorem.
The subject gamma is a single substitution and requires is, not are.
